fields.name: console settings
fields.meaning: Not used by this game: unchanged in every state (console owner data only)
fields.evidence: byte-identical in all 301 observed states

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Scratch space the game uses while running (map, picture and text buffers). Not part of the save: after loading, the game writes these bytes before it ever reads them; with no valid save the whole chip is wiped to zero
fields.evidence: code 2000:0acf (wipe 0000-7fff when no valid save); boot read trace of the natural save (no read-before-write here); diffs change it without any save

fields.name: signature 1
fields.meaning: Text "DEGITAL MONSTER " (spelled this way). Checked at power-on; if it does not match, the game treats the memory as empty and starts fresh
fields.evidence: code 2000:09d7 (check), 2000:0ad9 (write), ROM text at 2000:0b3d; boot reads

fields.name: clock hour
fields.meaning: In-game clock hour (0-23); a new game starts at 9 (in play kept at work address 1fa4)
fields.evidence: code 2000:02e5 (+1, wraps at 24), 2000:9b5f sets 9 at new game, 6000:5a8e resets 9 on waking; natural saves = 9

fields.name: clock minute
fields.meaning: In-game clock minute (0-59) (work 1fa5)
fields.evidence: code 2000:02d5 (+1, wraps at 60); natural saves = 0

fields.name: clock ticks
fields.meaning: Sub-minute counter; one game minute passes when it reaches 50, 25 or 5 depending on the clock speed setting (work 1fa6)
fields.evidence: code 2000:02bb, speed table 2000:03d5 = 32 19 05

fields.name: time of day
fields.meaning: Time-of-day phase worked out from the clock hour: hours 05-10 give 0 (morning), 11-15 give 1 (midday), 16-18 give 2 (evening), all other hours give 3 (night). Recomputed only while the area number is 1-4; a change triggers a scene update (work 1fa7)
fields.evidence: code 7000:0309-0336 (hour ranges, writes 0/1/2/3), 2000:0368 (compares old/new, updates scene); natural save hour 9 = 0

fields.name: clock speed
fields.meaning: Clock speed setting 0-2 (0 slowest, 2 fastest), cycled by an option; picks 50/25/5 ticks per game minute (work 1fa8)
fields.evidence: code 4000:0ea4 (cycles 0-1-2), 2000:02bf uses it as index; natural saves = 1

fields.name: current area
fields.meaning: Number of the area (room/map) the player is in when saving; 5 = the player's bedroom, 6 = the new-game start area. Copied from the live area number at save time and put back on load (work 1fa9 <- 0c7a)
fields.evidence: code 9000:7b3d (0c7a -> 1fa9 before writing), 2000:0a6b and 2000:92a6 (1fa9 -> 0c7a on load), 6000:5a9d sets 5; natural save = 5, loads in the bedroom

fields.name: return x
fields.meaning: Player x position remembered while in the first areas (area number below 5); a return point (work 1fab)
fields.evidence: code 7000:0059 copies 1fc1 -> 1fab when area < 5; 0 in saves taken in area 5

fields.name: return y
fields.meaning: Player y position for the return point (work 1fad)
fields.evidence: code 7000:005f; 0 in saves taken in area 5

fields.name: return facing
fields.meaning: Player facing for the return point (work 1faf)
fields.evidence: code 7000:0065; 0 in saves taken in area 5

fields.name: player name
fields.meaning: Player name in Shift-JIS (2 bytes per character), ended by a 00 byte; a new game fills in "PLAYER" in full-width letters (13 bytes from ROM). Room for 8 characters plus the terminator. The natural save holds "あ" (one character) (work 1fb0)
fields.evidence: code 2000:9b85 (default name copy, 13 bytes from ROM 2000:9b9f = full-width PLAYER + 00); natural save bytes 82a0 00

fields.name: player x
fields.meaning: Player x position in the area, in pixels (work 1fc1)
fields.evidence: diff between natural saves (200 -> 168 after walking left); code 2000:9b70 new game 120, 4000:15d2 reads it to place the player

fields.name: player y
fields.meaning: Player y position in the area, in pixels (work 1fc3)
fields.evidence: code 2000:9b76 new game 224, 6000:5aa9; unchanged (160) when only walking left/facing up

fields.name: player facing
fields.meaning: Direction the player faces: 0 = up, 2 = right, 4 = down, 6 = left (new game 4) (work 1fc5)
fields.evidence: diffs: 2 while facing the machines, 6 after walking left, 0 after pressing up (sprite faces away); code 2000:9b7c

fields.name: partner 1
fields.meaning: Which Digimon slot is the first partner following the player: the work address of its record (1fcc = slot 1), 0 = none (work 1fc6)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1598, 8000:05b9 (shift up when a Digimon is removed), 6000:4aa4 (name lookup); natural save = 1fcc

fields.name: partner 2
fields.meaning: Second partner slot pointer, 0 = none (work 1fc8)
fields.evidence: code 4000:1598, 8000:05bc; natural save = 0

fields.name: partner 3
fields.meaning: Third partner slot pointer, 0 = none (work 1fca)
fields.evidence: code 4000:15b2, 8000:05c2; natural save = 0

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: kind
fields.meaning: Kind of Digimon in this slot; ff = empty slot. Natural save = 15 hex (the Botamon seen in dialogue) (work 1fcc)
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff for all 8 slots in a fresh file), 9000:7e00 (ff when freed), 9000:08f6 (empty test)

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: name
fields.meaning: Digimon nickname, 8 characters Shift-JIS; natural save "ボタモンあああ２" (matches the name shown in dialogue)
fields.evidence: code 9000:08fd (name used as text from work 1fcd)

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: name end
fields.meaning: 00 after the name
fields.evidence: natural save

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: stats block
fields.meaning: Digimon values (levels, health, attack/defense/speed and similar; the status screen shows HP/POW/DEF/SPD). Exact byte meanings not mapped. In the natural save the bytes at +0x1b-1d and +0x24-26 hold the same triple (0b 08 0a) and +0x22/23 hold 16 16 (possibly current/max health)
fields.evidence: no differential change in play

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: growing value
fields.meaning: Value raised by the amount at +0x3c (capped at 99) when a timer entry for this Digimon runs out
fields.evidence: code 2000:0353 (add +0x3c, cap 0x63)

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: growth step
fields.meaning: Amount added to +0x3b when the timer runs out

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: more values
fields.meaning: Unmapped Digimon values (natural save: 09 00 14 07 07 07 07 2f 04 04 00 00 00 00 00 02 00 00)
fields.evidence: no differential change in play

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: object link
fields.meaning: Work-memory address of the on-screen object for this Digimon; only meaningful while running (saved as is)
fields.evidence: code 2000:0323 (sets a flag through it), 4000:15a5 ([record+4f] used as object pointer); natural save = 104e

fields.name: Digimon slot 1: tail
fields.meaning: Unmapped, all 00 in every save seen; the byte at +0x55 is cleared when a Digimon is removed (8000:058a)
fields.evidence: natural saves

fields.name: Digimon slot 2
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 3
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 4
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 5
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 6
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 7
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon slot 8
fields.meaning: Same 92-byte layout as slot 1; first byte ff = empty. Empty in all saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0b14 (ff marks), 8000:0593 / 9000:7dea (records moved in 0x5c steps)

fields.name: Digimon timers
fields.meaning: 24 entries of 7 bytes: countdown byte (+2), state word (+3), and the work address of a Digimon record (+5); the first two bytes are never referenced by the timer code. When the countdown ends, that Digimon's +0x3b value grows. All 00 in saves seen
fields.evidence: code 2000:0334 (loop 0x18 x 7 from work 22ac), 9000:7e06 (fix pointers when a record moves)

fields.name: item list
fields.meaning: 36 two-byte entries (item number, count); empty = 00. Food to give to Digimon is kept here (the give menu uses the item number and finds the first kept Digimon)
fields.evidence: code 2000:3a79 (fills from a table with count 1), 9000:7efb (reads item number by index); empty in saves seen

fields.name: streak counter
fields.meaning: Counter raised by 1 (up to 99) after a result with a success flag, reset to 0 otherwise, then the game saves at once (no save when already at 99); likely a win streak
fields.evidence: code c000:3430 (inc cap 0x63 / clear, then save 9000:7b49); natural saves = 0

fields.name: grid counter
fields.meaning: Task progress: cells still remaining of 450, drawn filled on a 28-wide grid display and counted down one per step
fields.evidence: code 2000:9b64 / 2000:3a45 set 1c2 hex, 7000:13bb (div by 28, draw), 7000:143b (decrement); natural saves = 450

fields.name: event flags
fields.meaning: 704 one-bit story/event flags (flag n = bit n%8 of byte n/8). Talking through the partner tutorial set flag 0x130
fields.evidence: code 5000:1231 (set bit), 5000:1224 (clear all 0x58 bytes); diff between natural saves

fields.name: unknown tail
fields.meaning: Last record bytes before the check value; 00 in all saves seen
fields.evidence: natural saves

fields.name: check value
fields.meaning: 32-bit sum of the 1116 record bytes 3b20-3f7b; 0 means no save
fields.evidence: recomputed on 42 save images (3 distinct saves); code 9000:7b6b writes, 2000:0a14 checks

fields.name: signature 2
fields.meaning: Text "SRAM 0628" + 00; checked after the record check passes
fields.evidence: code 2000:0a38 (check), 2000:0afe (write), ROM text at 2000:0b5d; boot reads

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Scratch space, not part of the save (same evidence as 0000)
fields.evidence: code 2000:0acf; boot read trace of the natural save; diffs change it without saving

fields.name: backup record
fields.meaning: Second copy of the record (same layout as 3b20-3f7b), written together with the main copy. Used only if the main copy fails its check: then it is copied back over the main copy
fields.evidence: code 9000:7b5f (write), 2000:0a76-0acc (check + restore); identical copies in natural saves

fields.name: backup check value
fields.meaning: 32-bit sum of 7000-745b, same rule as 3f7c
fields.evidence: recomputed on 42 save images; code 9000:7b8a, 2000:0a9a

fields.name: work memory
fields.meaning: Not part of the save; never seen written
fields.evidence: always 00; code 2000:0acf wipe

fields.name: signature 3
fields.meaning: Text "2002BANDAI/STING"; checked at power-on with signature 1
fields.evidence: code 2000:09f0 (check), 2000:0aed (write), ROM text at 2000:0b4d; boot reads

values.value: identical in every observed state; the game keeps its save in cartridge SRAM only
